reading.body:
All six podcasts tracked here publish transcripts or show notes, which distinguishes this list from general AI media coverage since every episode is searchable and citable text rather than audio alone.

The six split by audience rather than by topic. Latent Space and Practical AI are aimed at engineers actually building with AI, Dwarkesh and The Cognitive Revolution favor long-form interviews with researchers and lab leaders on capability and strategy, and Lex Fridman and TWIML cover a broader, decade-spanning interview archive. That split means a reader's choice among these six should follow what they want to learn from, technical practice, frontier lab thinking, or historical breadth, rather than treating them as interchangeable AI podcasts.

The data does not report episode counts, release frequency, or audience size for any of the six, only who hosts each show and what it covers.
